decision: The seven paths with >=159-atom cells are deferred from the local sparse-DFT pilot (owner decisions 2026-07-20): they carry ~44% of the pilot budget; the pilot proceeds on the remaining 23 paths per model.
reentry_condition: run on stronger hardware (the owner's GPU-class box or dedicated CPU fleet) with the anchor-sharded fallback from the preregistration; verdicts for these seven remain PENDING until then — they are NOT excluded from the campaign record, only deferred.
